import sys
sys.path.append('/opt/conda/envs/pyPESTO/lib/python3.9/site-packages')
import pypesto.optimization
import pypesto.objective
import pypesto.problem
import pypesto.visualize

# Create a simple model and problem
model = pypesto.problem.Model(pypesto.problem.SimpleFunction(f=lambda x: x**2))
objective = pypesto.problem.Objective(pypesto.problem.LeastSquares())
problem = pypesto.problem.Problem(model, objective)

# Define the optimization options
optimizer = pypesto.optimization.Optimizer(options={'max_iter': 100})

# Run the optimization
result = optimizer.minimize(problem)

# Visualize the results
pypesto.visualize.plot_results(result)

cd /workspace/pandas-dev__pandas__1.0 && python -c "
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Quick smoke tests for basic functionality
print('Testing basic pandas functionality...')

# Test 1: Simple indexing
s = pd.Series([1, 2, 3, 4, 5])
assert s[2] == 3
print('✓ Basic Series indexing works')

# Test 2: Boolean indexing on Series
mask = [True, False, True, False, True]
result = s[mask]
expected = pd.Series([1, 3, 5], index=[0, 2, 4])
assert result.equals(expected)
print('✓ Series boolean indexing works')

# Test 3: Index boolean indexing
idx = pd.Index([10, 20, 30, 40])
mask = np.array([True, False, True, False])
result = idx[mask]
expected = pd.Index([10, 30])
assert result.equals(expected)
print('✓ Index boolean indexing works')

# Test 4: Our fix
ser_bool = pd.Series([True, False, pd.NA], dtype='boolean')
result = idx[ser_bool]
expected = pd.Index([10])  # Only position 0 is True
assert result.equals(expected)
print('✓ Our fix works')

print('All smoke tests passed!')
"
